subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

Q _ L _ P _ P _ B P Q _ L B _ Q _ L _ P

options.text: P, B, Q, L, P, P, P, B
P, Q, P, L, P, B, P, B
P, P, P, P, B, B, L, Q
P, Q, B, P, L, P, B, P

solution:
Given:- Q _ L _ P _ P _ B P Q _ L B _ Q _ L _ P

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1.** P, B, Q, L, P, P, P, B **→ Q **P **L **B **P - **Q** P **L **B P - Q **P **L B **P **- Q **P **L **B **P

2. P, Q, P, L, P, B, P, B → Q P L **Q** P - **P** P L B P - Q P L B **B** - Q P L B P<
